faq.title: Good to Know
faq.intro: Can't find what you're looking for? Our team replies within a few hours.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: Standard delivery arrives in 3–5 business days and is complimentary on orders over $100. Express delivery (1–2 business days) is available at checkout for $15.

items.question: What is your return policy?
items.answer: You have 30 days from delivery to return or exchange unworn items with their tags attached. Returns are free within the US.

items.question: How do I find my size?
items.answer: Every product page has a fit note and a size chart. Most pieces are cut relaxed; choose your usual size for a classic fit.

items.question: Do you ship internationally?
items.answer: Yes — we ship to more than 40 countries. Duties and taxes are calculated at checkout.

items.question: How can I track my order?
items.answer: When your order leaves our warehouse you will receive an email with a tracking link.

accordions.title: Description
accordions.body: A relaxed band-collar shirt in lightweight linen that stays cool all day. Wear it with tailored trousers at the office or with denim at the weekend — it gets softer with every wash.

accordions.title: Fabric & details

accordions.title: Size & fit
